name: Customer accompanied, directed or coached by a third party
description: Another person speaks for, accompanies or dictates instructions to the customer, who may appear fearful, scripted or unable to explain the activity.
fp: Carers, relatives or interpreters may legitimately assist; assess the customer's autonomy.

links.name: Third party accompanies and directs the customer
links.ctx: Another person speaks for the customer or dictates instructions.

links.name: Customer appears fearful, unable to speak freely, or lacks own ID
links.ctx: Customer accompanied by a person who speaks for them, avoids eye contact, lacks access to documents or appears coached.

links.name: Customer follows instructions or is coached
links.ctx: In branch or in contact, the customer cannot explain transactions, reads from scripts, or is accompanied by a handler.
